content:
With Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals kicking off and AirPods Pro 3 still down at $50 off, we also have another round of Apple Watch Ultra 4 launch week early bird deals to scope out. These are live alongside the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, including the cheapest 2026 Studio Display at $240 off, early bird deals on the M6 Mac mini, as well as $50 off the brand new 2026 Mac Studio ahead of its release tomorrow. Read on for all the details below, including an exclusive on Satechi's charger lineup and more.

Amazon takes $50 off AirPods Pro 3 for iPhone 18 Pro launch day shipping

The new-generation Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 officially go on sale today, the brand new iPhone 18 Pro is arriving on doorsteps nationwide starting this morning, and what some consider the best companion for all of them, AirPods Pro 3, are still down at $50 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (orig. $249)

Apple's refurbished store has the cheapest 2026 Studio Display down at $240 for the first time, limited stock

We've seen a few notable deals on the 2026 Apple Studio Display over the past two weeks over at Amazon, but the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently stocking the cheapest model at a rare discount – $240 off the regular price.

Apple's refurbished store has the 2026 Apple Studio Display with tilt-adjustable stand on sale for $1,359 right now.

  • Thorough refurbishment process before sale
  • One year of Apple limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products available for purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping not available for refurbished products
  • Limited supply available

This is the standard entry-level $1,599 model Apple put out this spring with standard glass and a tilt-adjustable stand, now on sale for $240 below the brand new price.

We don't expect these to stick around long, so grab one while you can if interested.

For comparison, Amazon is currently at $1,540 and rarely dips below that. We did see it hit the $1,484 all-time low for the first time a couple weeks back, but never that close to the price the Apple Refurbished Store has it at today.

Amazon is shipping faster than Apple and undercutting them (tomorrow's official launch)

The all-new 18 Pro, AirPods 5, and Apple Watch models are now on sale, AirPods Pro 3 are still down at $50 off, while the M6 Mac mini pre-order deals are still live ahead of their official launch tomorrow, and Amazon is currently shipping select models faster than Apple right now.

The brand new M6 Mac mini, M5 Pro mini, and M5 Max Mac Studio all go on sale officially tomorrow. If you're looking to get in early on launch day, Amazon not only has the lowest prices across the board on each model, they're also shipping some models faster than Apple right now.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (orig. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (orig. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (orig. $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (orig. $1,699)
  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (orig. $2,499)

The 24GB/512GB M5 Pro mini pre-order deal at Amazon has gone back up to MSRP, we'll keep watching. The M6 models and the M5 Max Studio deal at nearly $50 off are still live though.

Apple's 2026 Mac Studio is down nearly $50 ahead of its launch tomorrow

In addition to the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals and pre-order discounts on AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, Amazon has brought back its earlier M6 Mac mini deals and is once again offering the all-new 2026 Mac Studio launch day at nearly $50 off as well.

Amazon has the brand new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage on sale right now for $2,449.99.

This is the entry-level model with an 18-core CPU and 32-core GPU, priced at $2,499.

Amazon is currently undercutting Apple by nearly $50 to lure early bird shoppers to its platform instead of buying direct from Apple. Unless you're trading in at Apple, it's worth keeping that $50 in your pocket.

Here are the Apple Watch Ultra 4 models that are still on sale at Amazon with early bird launch deals

As a new work week gets underway, some of the new Series 12 early bird launch deals are still rolling, and Amazon has also brought back early bird deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 4.

While the discounts aren't massive, if you're looking to grab the brand new Apple Watch Ultra 4 during the first wave of sales, you might as well save a bit of lunch money while you're at it.

If you don't plan to trade-in at Apple's official storefront or Best Buy, Amazon has the lowest prices across multiple Slate Titanium and Natural Titanium configurations, including a few models paired with the brand new translucent Ocean band.

Best iPhone 18 Pro accessories deals: cases, chargers, cables, more

Satechi's 2026 ChargeView desktop charger with display is down to a new low at 25% off exclusive for 9to5 readers

This 300W UGREEN 8-port smart desktop charger can replace your entire stack of chargers and is now down to $170 low

Amazon's early fall Prime Day deals are live now: Apple, Pixel, Anker, Grubhub $20 off, more
